basic_profile.bio: I'm a 21-year-old college student from Austin, Texas, majoring in Computer Science. I've recently gotten into online gaming, particularly Apex Legends, and I'm trying to improve my skills. I also have a growing interest in the stock market and cryptocurrencies, with a particular fascination for emerging technologies like Nikola Corporation. I usually browse Reddit during the evenings after classes finish, around 7-10 PM CST. I'm currently single and spend most of my free time gaming or exploring new tech trends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge comes primarily from self-teaching and online communities. I often follow tech news and engage in discussions about gaming strategies and emerging tech stocks. My educational background in computer science helps me understand technical discussions, although I'm still learning the ropes.
